stories.title: Series Preview — Cubs at Kansas City Royals, 3-Game Road Trip
stories.angle: 3-game road trip opens at Kauffman Stadium. Kevin Gausman makes his Cubs debut tonight at 7:10 PM CT. Clay Holmes debuts Saturday. Cubs (67-49) vs. Royals (48-68). Lead with matchup + series length + location; pitcher/stakes as kicker.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Cubs at Kansas City Royals — three games, Kauffman Stadium.

Kevin Gausman makes his Cubs debut tonight at 7:10 PM CT. Clay Holmes follows Saturday. The deadline haul arrives in KC.

The Royals are 48-68. The Cubs are here to handle business.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Walk-Off Win Recap — Bregman's 9th-Inning HR + PCA Steals Game in the 11th
stories.angle: Bregman 2-run shot off Varland in the 9th (two-strike, two-out, 12th HR) tied it 2-2. PCA led off 11th with single, broke for third, scored when Blue Jays catcher's throw sailed into left. 11th walk-off win of the season. Dylan Cease wasted (7 IP, 2 H, 10 K). NO score per has_score=False insight.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Bregman with a two-out, two-run shot in the ninth to tie it.

Then PCA singled in the 11th, broke for third, and scored when the Blue Jays throw sailed into left.

That's 11 walk-off wins this season. Good teams find a way.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Alex Bregman Hot Streak — .370, 1.082 OPS in Last 11 Games
stories.angle: Bregman quietly building a big second half. Last 11 games: .370 avg, 1.082 OPS. Hit 12th HR on Aug 6. Lineup depth angle alongside PCA MVP buzz. The Cubs' 3-4-5 punch is legitimate.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Alex Bregman in his last 11 games: .370 average, 1.082 OPS.

He's been quietly doing this while everyone is (rightfully) watching PCA. The third baseman is locked in at exactly the right time.

The Cubs' lineup is genuinely scary right now.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Edward Cabrera Rehab Update — 4 IP, 8 K, 0 BB, Mid-August Return on Track
